title: "cv model training visualization plots"
author: "Michele Wiseman"
date: "2026-01-22"
output: html_document
---

```{r cv training plots}
# =========================
# Libraries
# =========================
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)

# =========================
# Load data
# =========================
df <- read_csv("../spreadsheets/best_model_training_stats_jan_26_26_ep_44.csv")

# Optional: set best epoch marker (adjust if needed)
best_epoch <- df$Epoch[which.max(df$F1_macro_val)]  # picks epoch with best val macro F1

# =========================
# Plot 1: Train vs Val loss
# =========================

p1 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Epoch)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Train_loss, color = "Train"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Val_loss, color = "Validation"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = best_epoch, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Loss", y = "Loss", color = NULL) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.justification = "center",
    legend.box.just = "center",
    legend.margin = margin(t = -5, r = 0, b = 5, l = 0),   # pulls legend closer to title
    plot.title = element_text(margin = margin(b = 4))
  )

# =========================
# Plot 2: Validation macro F1
# =========================


p2 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Epoch)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = F1_macro_val), color = "#999999", linewidth = 0.75) +
  geom_line(aes(y = F1_sporulating_val), color = "#800074", linewidth = 0.75) +
  geom_line(aes(y = F1_infected_val), color = "#298c8c", linewidth = 0.75) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = best_epoch, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Validation macro and class-specific F1 metrics", y = "F1 (%)") +
  theme_classic() +
    ylim(90, 100)


p2

# =========================
# Plot 4: Validation macro recall
# =========================
p4 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Epoch)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Recall_macro), color="#1a80bb", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Precision_macro), color="#f2c45f", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = best_epoch, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Validation Macro Recall and Precision", y = "%") +
  theme_classic() +
  ylim(90, 100)

p4

# =========================
# Plot 5: Val loss only (clean view)
# =========================
p5 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Epoch)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Val_loss), color="#97a6c4", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Train_loss), color="#384860", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = best_epoch, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Loss", y = "Loss") +
  theme_classic()

p5

# =========================
# Plot 6: Train loss only (clean view)
# =========================
#p6 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Epoch, y = Train_loss)) +
#  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
#  geom_vline(xintercept = best_epoch, linetype = "dashed") +
#  labs(title = "Training Loss", y = "Loss") +
#  theme_classic()

# =========================
# Combine into 2 rows x 3 cols
# =========================
final_plot <- grid.arrange(p2, p4, p5, ncol = 3)
# =========================

# Print to screen
final_plot

# Save figure
ggsave("figures/training_curves_2x3_j26_ep44.pdf", final_plot,
       width = 8, height = 3, dpi = 300)
```
